title: feat(list): undo a list cell save from its toast or with Ctrl+Z

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuYR7S9QooMPa3pJTmPdpjad)_

Part of #35685 (slice S2 of three: undo, plus the own-writes fix the seat deferred to this slice in 7042779557; S3, the state-machine confirm and the drawer sync, follows in its own pull request, so the card stays open)

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `toastRecordSave` in `@object-ui/react` takes an optional fourth argument, an `action` button the toast carries (new exported type `RecordSaveToastAction`), and `RecordSaveSink`'s options accept that `action`; nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` — the "On an object's list page" section gains the Undo bullet (toast button, Ctrl+Z / Cmd+Z, a new guarded update, once per save, an editor keeps its own Ctrl+Z). No skill under `skills/` teaches the list's save or undo, so nothing there moves.
Flow: dev-thread rule (maintainer 2026-11-20 09:22:50Z 「所有 p1 都按照新规则执行」): the card thread builds itself; L1 and the isolated L2 run in parallel at hand-back (deviates from the rule in `contract-review.md` that the dispatching seat starts the L2, until the skill card lands).

## 维护者速读

- 列表页（所有用列表组件画出的表格）里改完一格自动保存后，右上角的「1行已保存」提示上多了「撤销」按钮；在表格的格子上按 Ctrl+Z（苹果电脑 Cmd+Z）也能撤销，从最近一次往前一次次撤。正在输入框里打字时 Ctrl+Z 仍然是撤销文字，不会动已保存的数据。
- 属于「列表行内编辑重做」专题，是逐格自动保存那张卡的第二片（第一片已合并）；顺带修了第一片审核留下的一处：记录抽屉里同一对象的相关列表，在外面表格保存时会漏掉一次刷新。
- 撤销是再发一次带版本校验的保存，把值改回保存前，服务器上真的改回去，审计里多一条记录；如果别人在这期间改过这条记录，会弹出和保存时一样的冲突对话框，不会悄悄覆盖。撤销失败会弹出原因，表格里的值不变。
- 无。

## What changes

**Undo of a select-first cell save** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `ObjectGrid`). Only a grid with `cellSelection` changes: every grid `ListView` draws (the scope Sales ruled in 7035276698).

- A landed cell save's toast ("1 row saved") carries an **Undo** button. **Ctrl+Z / Cmd+Z** on one of the grid's cells (the selected cell's typing catcher, or a focused cell) undoes the newest save, then the one before it (a stack of the last 50 saves). Each save is taken back once: its toast's button after Ctrl+Z took it back (or the reverse) writes nothing.
- An undo is a **new update, not a local rollback**: it writes the value each saved field held before the save, read off the row the save started from through `captureUpdateUndoData` (`@object-ui/core`, the rule the record page's Undo uses), so a relation goes back as its stored id, never the `$expand` record. Its `If-Match` is the version this grid's own newest write of the record answered (`writtenVersionsRef`, else the save's own answer), never a version a later load read: a change someone else made since then answers 409 and opens the same conflict dialog as a save instead of being overwritten (review round 1); an earlier save's Undo after a newer save of ours on the same record is guarded by that newer write's version. Cancel writes nothing, and a refused or cancelled undo is spent, so the next Ctrl+Z undoes the save before it. Each entry records its object, so a grid pointed at another object never aims an old entry there. The undo redraws only its row, from the write's answer, holding the record in the list's own-writes registry exactly as a save does, so nothing else is read again and a sorted row stays put.
- After an undo: the toast "Change undone" (`actions.undone`, the key the record page and the action runtime already raise). A refused undo: the toast "Save failed" with the server's message, and the row keeps the saved value.
- A save of a field the row does not carry offers **no Undo**, rather than a partial one (the same rule as the record page).
- The key: an open editor keeps Ctrl+Z as its own text undo (the editor input is not the catcher), Shift (redo) and Alt are not taken, and a cell of a grid nested inside this one belongs to that grid (the root carries `data-object-grid-root`). When the grid takes the key it stops it, so the console's shared Ctrl+Z stack (`useGlobalUndo`, which ignores input targets but not a focused cell) is not popped by the same press. With nothing to undo, the key goes on to whoever else listens.
- `defaultRowSave` is split: `writeRowInPlace` (the S1 select-first write and in-place redraw, unchanged in behaviour) is now shared by the save and its undo. The staged path for grids without `cellSelection` is unchanged.

**`toastRecordSave` takes an optional `action`** (`@object-ui/react`): the button rides the success or the warning variant alike; without it every call is byte-for-byte what it was.

**Carried fix (seat ruling 7042779557, found by L1-a 7041864536 and the declaration L2 on #35864).** `ObjectGrid` handed the host list's own-writes registry to its own row load even without `cellSelection`. `ListView`'s provider also wraps its record drawer, so a same-object related grid inside that drawer skipped the re-read of a record the outer grid was writing. The row load now takes the registry only under `cellSelection`; a grid without it re-reads on every write of its object again.

English fallbacks added to `objectGridTranslations.ts`, byte-identical to the `en` pack: `actions.undo`, `actions.undone`, `table.saveFailed` (all three already exist in every locale; no locale file changes).

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance lines this slice owns: "保存成功后点「撤销」或按 Ctrl+Z：值回到修改前，服务端也回去了" and "审计记录里每次提交一条，撤销另算一条" — both measured in the browser below (four audit rows for two saves and two undos).
- Reading I chose: Undo is the grid's own stack, not the console's shared `globalUndoManager`. The shared stack's runner writes with no `If-Match`, no conflict dialog and no in-place redraw, and the card requires the guarded update; so a cell save is not pushed there and the grid's Ctrl+Z does not pop it. Ctrl+Z works while focus is on one of the grid's cells.
- An undo is not itself undoable (no redo), and it does not show the cell's saving / saved mark (the toast says it). Neither is in the card.
- Not in this slice: the state-machine confirm and the drawer sync (S3), retiring `onBatchSave` (#35827).

## Tests

New, in the existing harness file `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.autosave-35685.test.tsx` (its `@object-ui/components` mock reads the toast; the five S1 cases are unchanged):
- someone else's later change answers 409 on the undo even after a re-read (the If-Match is the grid's own write's version), Cancel keeps their value, and the cancelled undo is spent;
- the toast's Undo writes the prior value with the save's version, redraws the row, reads nothing again, says "Change undone", and a second press writes nothing;
- Ctrl+Z and Cmd+Z undo the newest save first, each once; with nothing left the key writes nothing; a toast whose save Ctrl+Z already took back writes nothing;
- an earlier save's Undo is guarded by the newest version of its record;
- an open editor keeps Ctrl+Z: no undo is sent;
- a refused undo keeps the row and says why on a toast;
- control: without `cellSelection` the save toast carries no Undo;
- the record drawer's related grid (no `cellSelection`, inside a list's own-writes registry) reads again while the outer grid holds the record.

`ui/packages/react/src/record-save-feedback.test.ts`: an action rides the toast on either variant.

Ablation (each committed first, mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):
- row load handed `ownWrites` unconditionally again → "the record drawer's related grid reads again" fails (1 failed / 11 passed), restored → 12/12;
- the undo's row taken from the save's leftover row instead of the row drawn now → "an earlier save's Undo is guarded by the newest version" fails (1 / 11), restored → 12/12.

- review round 1: the undo sent without its own-write guard → "someone else's later change answers 409" fails (1 / 13), restored → 13/13.

Migrated or voided: none.

## Review round 1 (head `e92be60e`, after `43e54611`)

- L2 7046653227 should-fix 1: the undo's `If-Match` is now the version this grid's own write answered, so a re-read that brought someone else's change no longer lets the undo overwrite it. Should-fix 2: the conflict case above (dialog, Cancel keeps the value). Nits: each undo entry records its object; the docs and changeset say a refused or cancelled undo is used up and that a toast's Undo takes back its own save while Ctrl+Z goes newest first.
- L1-a 7046240159 should-fix: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` › `records-forms.record-edit-undo` (revision 8: fixtures.requires[0] and knownGaps[1] say a list cell save has its own guarded Undo, on the grid's stack, not the shared one these clauses read; `blocked` unchanged) and `ux-conventions.json` › `ux-conventions.write-feedback` (revision 16: knownGaps[3] names the list cell save beside the import). `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: OK.
- Local on `e92be60e`: `ObjectGrid.autosave-35685` 13/13; all of `plugin-grid` and `plugin-list` 476 files, 4530 tests passed; `plugin-grid` type-check clean; eslint 0 errors; `dispatch-gates --commands` 73 families (the checklist edit adds `check:platform-checklist`), rerun on this head: see the seat's thread for the reconcile.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local runs (head 1837a4af, before the main merge 43e54611, which brought four commits touching none of these packages)</summary>

- `vitest` from `ui/` over `packages/plugin-grid/ packages/plugin-list/ packages/react/ packages/app-shell/` (app-shell included because its tests pin list keyboard behaviour): Test Files 2965 passed, 1 skipped (2966); Tests 28161 passed, 9 skipped (28170); 0 failed.
- `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and the test tsconfig) for `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: clean. `eslint` on every changed source and test file: 0 errors.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 72 derived families, each run with its exit captured before any pipe, all exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` and `check:skill-examples` re-run after the full package build their prerequisite needed; `vitest run scripts/` under `ui/` re-run with one worker after the container's memory limit killed the first two runs). `--ran`: 72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean.
- Changed lines about 500 vs the 3000 threshold: under.

</details>

<details><summary>Browser (after only; the before state is "no Undo" by construction)</summary>

`examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --fresh --seed-admin`, own port and temp DB) with the `ui/apps/console` Vite dev server over it, headless Chromium 1600×1000, zh-CN, head 1837a4af. Project list:

- Edit "Data Platform" → "Data Platform U", Enter: one `PATCH` `{"name":"Data Platform U"}` with `If-Match` the read version; the toast 「1行已保存」 carries one 「撤销」 button.
- Press 「撤销」: one `PATCH` `{"name":"Data Platform"}` with `If-Match` the save's answered version; the cell reads "Data Platform"; the toast 「已撤销更改」.
- Edit to "Data Platform K", Enter, ArrowUp back to the cell, Ctrl+Z: one `PATCH` `{"name":"Data Platform"}` with the second save's answered version; the cell reads "Data Platform".
- Reload: the first row reads "Data Platform" (the server holds the restored value).
- `sys_audit_log` for the record: four `update` rows, one per submit (U, back, K, back).
- Not measured: Safari / WebKit (no WebKit build in the container); the 409 dialog on an undo in the browser (covered by the unchanged conflict path and the unit cases).

</details>
